contradiction_resolution: AUDIT OF FND-0141 (candidate_key z-regular-immersion-codim-4-from-S-smoothness, kind lemma, evidence_class adversarial_review, originating reviewer engine grok, impacts C66-COMP-RANK). Verdict: promote candidate -> corroborated, with the scope recorded above; merge target none. (1) NO CLAIM-LEVEL CONTRADICTION. contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001-THM-0007, OBS-0001 or RED-0001: it is a relative-geometry lemma over an auxiliary balanced tetragonal base, making no assertion about weights, Tate type, or W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q). It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5, so n=6 is outside published CKgP range and new geometry is exactly what the C66-GEO-* chain must supply). (2) THE ABSTRACT ENGINE IS VERIFIED AGAINST PRIMARY SOURCES AND IS CORRECT. Stacks Project Divisors Lemma 31.23.11 (tag 067U) states that an immersion i: Z -> X of schemes over S with both Z -> S and X -> S smooth is a regular immersion; Section 37.17 (0H1G) confirms this is the intended closed-immersion-between-smooth-schemes statement. Over the locally Noetherian base of the finding, with all schemes of finite type, Koszul-regular/H_1-regular/quasi-regular and regular coincide, so 'regular immersion' is unambiguous. For the conormal data: Stacks Section 37.63 (06BB) gives that C_{Z/Conf_6} -> i^*Omega_{Conf_6/S} -> Omega_{Z/S} -> 0 is a SHORT exact sequence because the composite Z -> S is smooth; since Z -> S smooth makes Omega_{Z/S} finite locally free of rank 2, the surjection splits locally and the kernel C_{Z/Conf_6} is locally free of rank 6 - 2 = 4. Hence all four structural conclusions (regular immersion, pure codimension 4, rank-4 locally free conormal, locally split conormal sequence) follow formally from the two smoothness statements, exactly as the finding asserts. Note that rank-4 local freeness of the conormal here does not even require 067U; it falls out of the split conormal sequence, so the finding's derivation is if anything over-strong rather than under-supported. (3) THE TWO SMOOTHNESS INPUTS ARE SUPPLIED BY ALREADY-CORROBORATED PACKET FINDINGS, NOT BY THIS FINDING, AND THEY CLOSE. (a) Ambient: Conf_6(C/S) is open in C^{x_S 6} for C/S smooth proper of relative dimension 1, hence S-smooth of pure relative dimension 6. (b) h^0(L) = 3 CONSTANTLY on the balanced+(N) locus, which is the prerequisite FND-0058 flagged as unproved: FND-0073 gives h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) with deg M = 4; under (N), FND-0105 gives M ~= O_C(D), so h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(D); h^0(D) >= 2 always (gamma^* injective on H^0(P^1,O(1))); FND-0103 (Clifford, M always special) gives h^0(D) <= 3 with equality only if C is hyperelliptic and D ~ 2 g^1_2; FND-0104 makes that equality equivalent to gamma being non-primitive; FND-0135 shows a hyperelliptic genus-6 curve with a degree-4 pencil forces gamma = q o h; and FND-0125 computes that this non-primitive case has E = O(1)+O(4)+O(4) and F = O(2)+O(7), maximally unbalanced, hence excluded from the balanced locus. So h^0(D) = 2 and h^0(L) = 3 identically on the balanced+(N) base. GAP-H0-1 is therefore closed on that locus, and FND-0141 is entitled to relative dimension 2. (c) With S reduced and h^0(L) constant, Grauert gives pi_*L locally free of rank 3 with formation commuting with base change, so P_S(pi_*L) is S-smooth of pure relative dimension 2; by FND-0107 plus the smooth-atlas descent recorded in FND-0127, P_S(pi_*L) is canonically the Abel-Jacobi incidence Sym^6(C/S) x_{Pic^6} S over the h^0-constant locus, i.e. the scheme-theoretic fibre of the Abel-Jacobi map, whose functor of points is precisely {relative effective degree-6 divisors Gamma with O(Gamma) ~= L up to a line bundle from the base}. (d) SCHEME STRUCTURE, which is where FND-0046's warning bites and where the finding survives it: FND-0096 computes universally on C x_S Pic^0 that Fit_0(coker(p_*L_univ -> p_*(L_univ|_{Gamma_P}))) = I_e, the ideal of the zero section, the intrinsic derivative being the perfect Serre pairing; Fitting ideals commute with base change, so pulling back along a_N: Conf_6(C/S) -> Pic^0 identifies the evaluation-failure ideal with the ideal of the scheme-theoretic preimage a_N^{-1}(e), i.e. with the Abel-Jacobi incidence scheme structure, not merely with its geometric points. FND-0097 and FND-0099 justify the filtered reduction Fit_0(coker phi) = Fit_0(coker phi_5) without assuming W splits, using deg W_4 = 4g+12-16 = 20 > 2g-2 = 10 (so R^1 pi_* W_4 = 0) and deg W_4(-Gamma) = 14 > 10 (so coker(phi_4) = 0). (e) Nonemptiness and density of the reduced-support open in every fibre: FND-0134 (L base-point-free on the balanced locus, since a base point would give a g^2_5 forcing a smooth plane quintic whose tetragonal pencil is CE-unbalanced by FND-0130; then phi_L: C -> P^2 finite and, in characteristic zero, separable, so a general line pulls back to six distinct points). FND-0136 shows the nonreduced locus in |L| is also nonempty, so the reduced-support locus is a proper dense open - consistent with, and the reason for, Z being only that piece. (f) Ordered cover: FND-0064 and FND-0075 give the finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open, hence S-smoothness of Z of the same relative dimension 2. (g) Closedness of Z in Conf_6(C/S): the condition O(Gamma) ~= L is closed because the relative Picard is separated (FND-0107), and inside Conf_6 the support is automatically reduced, so the reduced-support restriction imposes no further openness. Z is therefore genuinely CLOSED in Conf_6(C/S), even though the corresponding locus is only open inside Sym^6(C/S) and inside M_{6,6}. (4) THE FINAL CLAUSE IS THE SUBSTANTIVE METHODOLOGICAL CONTENT AND IS CORRECT. By FND-0122 the corank of phi_5 on the failure locus is exactly 1 (rank in {5,6}); for an 11 -> 6 map of bundles the generic expected codimension of corank 1 is (11-5)(6-5) = 6, whereas the actual codimension is 4. The locus is therefore in the excess regime, generic-determinantal lci theorems do not apply, and any attempt to read off regularity from the determinantal expectation would give the wrong number. The excess dimension 2 is independently confirmed twice: it equals h^1(L) = h^0(L) - chi(L) = 3 - 1 = 2, and it equals the rank of the excess cokernel R^1 pi_* L identified (up to the convention-dependent line twist) in FND-0133. This positively resolves, in the balanced+(N) setting, the direction left open by FND-0068 ('a degeneracy locus whose component has codimension below the generic determinantal expectation may still be locally cut out by a regular sequence of its actual codimension'). One wording nit: 'the excess of actual codimension 4 over the filtered determinantal expectation 6' reads backwards, since 4 < 6; the intended and correct content is that the actual codimension falls BELOW the expectation, with excess dimension 2. Downstream artifacts should restate it that way. (5) DISTINCTNESS / NO MERGE. The candidate_key z-regular-immersion-codim-4-from-S-smoothness matches no adjudicated finding. Nearest neighbours are all distinct: FND-0068 is the negative statement that a nowhere-lci conclusion needs depth/conormal work (FND-0141 is the positive lci conclusion in a specified setting); FND-0058 is the dimension prerequisite; FND-0107 is the Abel-Jacobi representability model; FND-0096/0097/0099 supply the Fitting/filtered machinery; FND-0052 concerns non-closedness inside M_{6,6}. merge_target_id is null. (6) SCOPE SHARPENINGS THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH THE FINDING (these are why the verdict is corroborated rather than mechanically_verified). (6a) AMBIENT DISCIPLINE. Closedness and codimension 4 hold inside Conf_6(C/S) over the balanced+(N) base S. They do NOT hold, and are not claimed, inside M_{6,6}: FND-0052, FND-0067 and FND-0091 are untouched. Conf_6(C/S) is itself only open in C^{x_S 6}, and S is only the balanced locus, so Z is not closed in any family that includes unbalanced tetragonal fibres; the unbalanced CE stratification remains unconstructed (FND-0091), with FND-0125 the sole explicit point. Any downstream Gysin, excess-intersection or support-filtration use in C66-COMP-RANK must state which ambient it is working in, or it will silently import a closedness that was proved only relative to Conf_6(C/S). (6b) HYPOTHESIS (N) IS UNDISCHARGED. (N) is GAP-Z-W5D. The finding conditionalizes correctly, in line with FND-0101; downstream artifacts must keep the '(N)' marker rather than relabel it an established working-context fact (the precise failure FND-0105 warns against). (6c) CHARACTERISTIC ZERO IS USED BUT NOT STATED. The nonemptiness/density input (FND-0134) uses separability of phi_L and Bertini; the statement should be amended to record characteristic zero (or a separability hypothesis). Without it, 'pure relative dimension two' - which requires Z -> S surjective with all fibres of dimension 2 - is not established in general. (6d) REDUCEDNESS IS LOAD-BEARING ONLY THROUGH GRAUERT, AND ITS REMOVABILITY IS OPEN. The regular-immersion step (067U) needs no reducedness; reducedness enters solely to make pi_*L locally free of rank 3 with base change. The natural route to removing it is the degree-shifted cohomology-and-base-change statement applied at i = 1 (h^1(L_s) = 2 is likewise constant), which would give R^1 pi_* L locally free of rank 2 and the degree-0 base-change map an isomorphism. This audit checked Stacks Section 30.5 (02KE) and found no such lemma there, and did not confirm the theorem text in the Nitsure FGA-Explained survey (abstract page only). Accordingly FND-0131 STANDS: over nonreduced bases the conclusion is not established, and the finding must not be quoted over such bases until a citable constant-fibre-dimension statement is added to the corpus. (7) INDEPENDENCE. FND-0141 originates from a grok adversarial review (source_review_ids REV-0142, source_attempt_ids ATT-0088), and grok is in this campaign's excluded_engines. This audit was performed entirely on claude: no grok worker was dispatched (the optional single-worker allowance was deliberately left unused to preserve engine independence from the originating reviewer), and every load-bearing step above was verified directly by the adjudicator against primary sources or against already-corroborated packet findings. (8) PROVENANCE CAVEAT ON HASHES. content_sha256 is null on every source record: this read-only workspace exposes no shell or hashing capability, so no genuine digest of retrieved content could be computed. Rather than emit unverifiable 64-hex strings, the digests are omitted and the retrieved substance is quoted in each record's note. ATT-0088 and REV-0142 were not re-audited at section level (neither artifact is present in this workspace); that provenance is not required for the mathematical adjudication above. (9) RECOMMENDED PROMOTED STATEMENT. Promote to corroborated with evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source, amending the statement to (i) say 'characteristic zero', (ii) say explicitly 'closed in Conf_6(C/S), not in M_{6,6}', and (iii) replace 'the excess of actual codimension 4 over the filtered determinantal expectation 6' with 'actual codimension 4 falls below the filtered determinantal expectation 6, excess dimension 2 = rank R^1 pi_* L'.

scope.codimension_arithmetic: rel dim Conf_6(C/S) = 6, rel dim Z = 2, codim = 4 (pure); filtered determinantal expectation for the corank-1 locus of phi_5: ranks 11 -> 6 (deg W_5 = 4g+12-4*5 = 16 > 2g-2 = 10 so h^0(W_5) = 16-6+1 = 11; deg Gamma = 6), expected codim (11-5)(6-5) = 6; excess dimension 2 = h^1(L) = h^0(L) - chi(L) = 3 - 1 = rank R^1 pi_* L.

source_records.note: Stacks Project, Divisors, Lemma 31.23.11 (tag 067U): for an immersion i: Z -> X of schemes over S with Z -> S smooth and X -> S smooth, i is a regular immersion. This is the exact abstract engine the finding invokes. Retrieved statement: 'Let Y -> S be smooth, X -> S smooth, and i an immersion. Then i is a regular immersion.'

Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Section 37.17 'Closed immersions between smooth schemes'; its Lemma 37.17.1 (tag 0FUE) cites Divisors Lemma 31.23.11 (067U) for exactly the closed-immersion-between-S-smooth-schemes case, confirming the intended reading of 067U.

Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Section 37.63: for g: Z -> Y formally unramified (in particular an immersion) over X, the sequence C_{Z/Y} -> g^*Omega_{Y/X} -> Omega_{Z/X} -> 0 is a SHORT exact sequence when the composite Z -> X is smooth or formally smooth (Morphisms Lemma 29.35.17 / More on Morphisms Lemma 37.11.12). The page does not itself assert local splitting; local splitting is then elementary since Omega_{Z/S} is finite locally free for Z -> S smooth, and the kernel C_{Z/Y} is therefore locally free of rank 6 - 2 = 4.

Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Section 30.5 'Cohomology and base change, I'. Checked specifically for a citable constant-fibre-dimension (Grauert-type) statement that would let the reducedness hypothesis on S be dropped. NEGATIVE result: this section contains only Lemmas 30.5.1 (02KG), 30.5.2 (02KH, flat base change) and 30.5.3 (0CKW, finite locally free base change); the constant-h^i lemma is not here. Recorded so the sharpening in item 6d is not over-claimed.

Nitsure, 'Construction of Hilbert and Quot Schemes' (FGA Explained). Candidate locator for the degree-shifted cohomology-and-base-change statement (constant dim H^i(X_s,F_s) = d implies R^i pi_* F locally free of rank d and base change iso in degree i-1, with no reducedness hypothesis on S). ONLY the arXiv abstract page was retrieved; the theorem text and numbering were NOT confirmed. Cited as an unverified lead for item 6d, not as verification.
